name: zrndr_fog_blend_span_565_scalar
description: zRndr::FogBlendSpan565Scalar blends a 5:6:5 destination span toward the active fog color using fixed-point fog coordinates and the packed fog ramp.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification with vc5_o2_ob0_facs currently fails: original 0x49e200 is 249 bytes, the compiled source loop is 112 bytes, 8 relocation bytes are masked, 11 trailing VC NOPs are trimmed, and 240 unmasked byte mismatches remain.

A temporary VC5SP3 profile sweep did not find an acceptable tier S shape: vc5_o2_ob1_gx_facs matched the ob0 result, while vc5_o2_ob2_facs and vc5_o2_ob2_gx_facs compiled to 368 bytes with 341 unmasked mismatches.

The mismatch is explained by source-shape/codegen limits: the retail routine inlines the odd-pixel and packed-pair fog channel math with its frame-pointer/prologue shape, while the current source preserves verified behavior through shared FogBlendPixel565/FogBlendPair565 helpers.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x49e200 validates the odd-pixel head path, two-pixel packed loop, fogCoordFixed24/fogCoordStepFixed24 advancement, fixed-point thresholds at 0x80000 and 0x1000000, packed fog ramp indexing, and full-fog color stores.
The native smoke verifies a five-pixel span covering the odd head and two packed pairs, the full-fog replacement path, and the under-threshold no-op path.
